name: Receipt Maker
intro: You will set up a pretend church, enter a cash gift and a gift of a desk, and make the two tax thank-you letters — then check a skipped row, reload, go offline and print.

steps.do: On the welcome card at the bottom, tap “skip the tour” (small words, bottom-right).
steps.see: The card changes to “How do you want to start?” with two big buttons.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”. A small box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.” — tap “OK”.
steps.see: The card closes. You see “1 · Your organization” with four empty boxes, and “2 · The gifts” with one empty row numbered 1. A purple “🧪 Test copy” bar is at the bottom.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “✉️ Make the letters” with everything still empty.
steps.see: No letters. A small box says “Fill in your organization name first.” Tap “OK”.

steps.do: Scroll up, tap the “Organization name” box and type this.
steps.see: The name is in the box.

steps.do: Tap the “EIN” box and type this pretend number.
steps.see: The number is in the box.

steps.do: Tap the “Signer (name & title)” box and type this.
steps.see: The name and title are in the box, apostrophe and all.

steps.do: In row 1 under “2 · The gifts”, tap the “donor name” box and type this.
steps.see: The names are in the first box of row 1.

steps.do: Tap the “amount” box in row 1 and type this.
steps.see: 1,200 is in the amount box.

steps.do: Tap the “date received” box in row 1 and pick March 14, 2026 with the little 📅 calendar, then tap Done. (If you type it instead, many computers want the MONTH first: 03/14/2026.)
steps.see: The date box shows March 14, 2026 (your phone may write it as 3/14/2026 or Mar 14, 2026).

steps.do: Tap “✚ Add another donor”, then type this in the new row's “donor name” box.
steps.see: A row numbered 2 appears and “Pastor Dan” is in its name box.

steps.do: Tap the “amount” box in row 2 and type this (it's a gift of a thing, not money).
steps.see: The words are in the amount box of row 2.

steps.do: Tick the box “We are a church” (under the gift rows).
steps.see: The box is ticked. “No goods or services were provided…” is ticked too (it starts that way).

steps.do: Tap “✉️ Make the letters”.
steps.see: It says “2 letters ready below. Print puts each on its own page.” The first letter starts with “Grace Community Church · EIN 12-3456789”, today's date, “Dear Bill & Ann O’Connor,” and thanks them for “your generous gift of $1,200.00, received on March 14, 2026”. It includes “other than intangible religious benefits” and is signed “Margaret O’Brien, Treasurer”.

steps.do: Scroll down to the second letter.
steps.see: “Dear Pastor Dan,” thanks him for “your generous in-kind gift of used office desk”, with a small note that the donor determines the value of in-kind gifts.

steps.do: Scroll up, tap “✚ Add another donor”, type this name in row 3 (leave its amount empty), then tap “✉️ Make the letters”.
steps.see: Still two letters. The line says “2 letters ready below. Skipped 1 row(s): Mary Smith (no amount).” — so nobody is left out without you knowing.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Your organization details and all three gift rows are still there. The letters themselves are not kept — you make them again with one tap. After a moment a card “Keep Receipt Maker on your Home Screen” pops up at the bottom — tap “Later”.
steps.tip: Look at the “We are a church” box: after a reload it is unticked again. Tick it before the next step, and please mention this in your notes.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Make sure “We are a church” is ticked, then tap “✉️ Make the letters”.
steps.see: A brown bar at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” The letters are made anyway: “2 letters ready below. Skipped 1 row(s): Mary Smith (no amount).”

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off (the brown bar goes away). Tap “🖨 Print them all” (just under “✉️ Make the letters”).
steps.see: A print preview opens with the two letters, each on its own page, without the boxes and buttons. Tap Cancel.

steps.do: Scroll up to row 3 (Mary Smith) and tap the × at the end of that row.
steps.see: The Mary Smith row disappears; rows 1 and 2 are left.

steps.do: Tap “✉️ Make the letters” one last time.
steps.see: “2 letters ready below. Print puts each on its own page.” — nothing skipped any more. That's the end — thank you!
